layouts.name: Gotland Ring 3.1
layouts.description: Draft route hypothesis: the source cycle is the unique closest nominal-distance match within conservative timing and distance checks. Approximate OSM trace length 3052.6 m. Difference from the supplied layout distance 7.4 m. Course configuration still requires visual review.

layouts.name: Gotland Ring 4.1
layouts.description: Southern loop with its western outer bend, inner return and full eastern straight. The operator identifies the 4.1 km Southern Loop; the full course plan separates paddock, karting and energy-road access, all excluded. Native satellite ground resolution is 10 m. Nearest-neighbor rendering does not add resolution. Fine corner alignment and historical direction remain draft; no vertices are fitted to private diagrams, timing positions or nominal distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 4075.3 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

layouts.name: Gotland Ring 6.0
layouts.description: Combined course uses the Southern Loop and the eastern Northern Loop through the mapped northern crossover, bypassing the northern western technical section. The operator explicitly lists a 6.0 km alternative. Independent public course ways fix the northern branch choice; the full circuit plan identifies the two connecting course roads. Paddock, pit and karting branches are excluded. Native satellite ground resolution is 10 m. Nearest-neighbor rendering does not add resolution. Fine corner alignment and historical direction remain draft; no vertices are fitted to private diagrams, timing positions or nominal distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 5977.2 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

layouts.name: Gotland Ring 7.3
layouts.description: Full Grand Prix configuration uses the Southern Loop and the complete northern western and eastern technical sections. The operator identifies its full 7.3 km configuration and connecting course roads. Paddock, pit, karting and the northern short-loop closing straight are excluded. Native satellite ground resolution is 10 m. Nearest-neighbor rendering does not add resolution. Fine corner alignment and historical direction remain draft; no vertices are fitted to private diagrams, timing positions or nominal distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 7303.6 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
